source: Hawaii Department of Taxation, Annual Report, tables 'Tax Collections', 'State General Fund' and 'General Excise and Use Tax Base and Taxes' (index: https://tax.hawaii.gov/stats/a5_1annual/a5_1tax_annuals/)
units: thousands of dollars, fiscal year ending June 30
limitations: Cash collections by fiscal year (July to June), in thousands of dollars, as DOTAX's annual report prints them. Includes taxes collected by the counties (motor vehicle), the Insurance Commissioner (insurance premiums) and the Bureau of Conveyances (conveyance).

Rows change over time: the county surcharge starts in FY2007 (Honolulu only until FY2019); through FY2018 the fuel row includes the environmental response tax and motor vehicle includes rental vehicles (state_revenue.lines.HOST).

The general fund table is what the general fund kept of each line after transfers to special funds and the counties; the transient accommodations, conveyance and fuel taxes are mostly elsewhere, and their shares follow the law of the year.
Individual and corporate income tax for FY2017 on are not comparable to earlier years: DOTAX changed how it compiles them (FY2018 report, Table 1.8 note 4).
